hooks.name: player_destroy_item
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge's PlayerDestroyItemEvent carries the original stack and a hand, which armour has not; this hook only listens and names the slot instead. Bukkit's PlayerItemBreakEvent)

doc_summary: a player's item breaking: `native_player_destroy_item(player, name, item, slot)` is heard for a server player whose tool, shield, rod or armour piece ran out of durability (`LivingEntity.onEquippedItemBroken`, Bukkit's `PlayerItemBreakEvent`), with the item that broke and the slot it was in (`mainhand`, `offhand`, `head`, `chest`, `legs`, `feet`, `body`, `saddle`); armour has a slot rather than a hand. `native_item_damaged` is the wear, this is only the break. Listen only. The player's state is swapped in. Not heard for a creative player or for the host of a LAN world. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:native_player_destroy_item@`.
